selection_rule: All16 ranks actual width6 at identical verified global dispatch step; first continuous intersection; discard100 full points then51 shared endpoints=50 raw intervals per round, two rounds. No timing values select or remove points.

model.name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
model.hash_scope: checkpoint metadata and tensor headers, not complete tensor payload

configuration.layout: two nodes, eight GPUs per node

limits: Host-specific completion clocks are used only within each rank; cross-host absolute timestamps are not directly compared.
The primary score uses rank0 mean across the two fixed global windows; all-rank intervals and distributions are retained as diagnostics.
Synchronized long tails remain in the results; compile counters alone do not exclude every vendor JIT. Causes await independent diagnostic traces.

reanalysis.method: Strict global auditor and independent reconstruction of new raw completion points

network_identity_scope.recorded: Requested NIC map, NCCL HCA allowlist, GID, worker NIC selection in completion records and native dependency identity

rank_interval_distribution_ms.percentile_method: linear interpolation of all raw interval values
